name: What types of interior damage are covered by insurance-coordinated restoration?

mainEntity.name: What types of interior damage are covered by insurance-coordinated restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insurance-coordinated restoration typically covers a wide range of interior damages depending on your specific policy. Common types include water damage from plumbing leaks, burst pipes, or appliance malfunctions; fire and smoke damage affecting walls, ceilings, and flooring; and mold remediation resulting from covered water damage. It can also include damage from natural events like storms (wind, hail) impacting the interior. It's important to review your specific insurance policy to understand your coverage details.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commonly covered damages include water, fire, smoke, and mold remediation resulting from insured events. Check your policy for specifics.
